title: Holiday Gifts Schedule
bodyHtml:
All shards have now received the Holiday gifts publish, and these gifts will be active following their next maintenance period (that means the first shard will now be Oceania, which undergoes its normal maintenance at 2:00 PM CST, 7:00 AM local Australia time). This means a slight change for the Lake Austin shard, since we had a small publish issue that prevented Lake Austin from getting their holiday gifts this morning as planned. But they will be active along with all other shards after their next regularly scheduled maintenance time, which you can find here.

Thanks, and Happy Holidays!

대충 내용을 요약하면, 모든 샤드는 이제 Holiday Gift를 서버다운 후에 받게 될것이라는 내용입니다.
